exposure: Timing of glucose tolerance test (early vs. standard postpartum period)
Patients who elected early glucose tolerance testing
Patients who deferred testing to the standard postpartum period
cohort: Patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) at a tertiary center
finding: Adherence rates to glucose tolerance testing were higher when the test was offered during delivery hospitalization compared to when it was deferred until the standard postpartum period.
mod_finding: There were significant differences in adherence to early glucose tolerance testing between those who delivered vaginally versus by cesarean.
